title: Training Note: Tenure Addition on Restored Residential Electricity Supply Dual-Fuel Credits
content:
Training note, Residential Electricity Supply. A restored dual-fuel credit carries a tenure addition that depends on how long the electricity agreement has been in supply.

**Rule.** When the agreement's service start date is 24 or more whole months before the restoration date, the long-tenure addition of 1.00 USD is added; when it is 12 to 23 whole months before, the mid-tenure addition of 0.50 USD is added; when it is fewer than 12 whole months before, nothing is added.

**Q. Which date starts the count?**
A. The service start date recorded on the agreement, the switch meter read date on which Beacon Ridge supply began.

**Q. What is a whole month here?**
A. A month is whole once the same day of the month has been reached. From a service start date of 2024-03-15, the 2026-03-14 restoration date is 23 whole months later and earns 0.50 USD; on 2026-03-15 it is 24 whole months and earns 1.00 USD.

**Q. And at the lower boundary?**
A. From a service start of 2025-03-15, a restoration on 2026-03-15 is 12 whole months and earns 0.50 USD; on 2026-03-14 it is 11 whole months and nothing is added.

| Whole months from service start to restoration | Tenure addition |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 1.00 USD |
| 12 to 23 | 0.50 USD |
| fewer than 12 | nothing |
